title: Rolling Stone COMPASS carbon road frameset
notes: The out-of-stock regional page identifies COMPASS as a carbon road frameset and lists Toray T800 UD, BB86, 1,030 g frame, 390 g fork, 195 g aero seatpost, mechanical/electronic compatibility and a frame/fork/seatpost/clamp/headset package. Its differing weights are retained as retailer claims and are not averaged with the independent measurement. The page publishes no COMPASS maximum tire clearance.
